records.title: Déjà View: Looping Transformers for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction
records.reason: Déjà View applies a looped transformer to multi-view 3D reconstruction and studies parameter-efficient recurrent depth. Limitations say recurrence does not extrapolate beyond trained loop-step range and channels diverge past it. Related to looped computation, but not LLM inference.

records.title: DVAO: Dynamic Variance-adaptive Advantage Optimization for Multi-reward Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: DVAO estimates reward variance and adapts GRPO advantage weights for multi-reward RL; experiments are training-side on 8 H20 GPUs. Limitations discuss dependence on group variance estimates. It does not target inference cost or serving; relation to efficient reasoning is weak.

records.title: LASAR: Latent Adaptive Semantic Aligned Reasoning for Generative Recommendation
records.reason: LASAR uses latent semantic-aligned reasoning and adaptive latent-step allocation for generative recommendation; experiments use Qwen3-based models on three datasets. Its limitation notes sequential, hard-to-parallelize latent feedback; general LLM inference transfer is unestablished.

records.title: Is One Layer Enough? Understanding Inference Dynamics in Tabular Foundation Models
records.reason: Tabular foundation-model inference dynamics, distinct from LLM/VLM inference; no serving improvement established.

records.title: When Language Overwrites Vision: Over-Alignment and Geometric Debiasing in Vision-Language Models
records.reason: VLM hallucination/geometric debiasing addresses representation accuracy rather than inference cost.
